gloss: seal box; space for a stamp on a form

definitions.gloss: seal column; box for affixing a personal seal
definitions.explanation: The small marked space on a form or contract where a personal seal is to be stamped. Found on applications, delivery slips, and official paperwork.

examples.japanese: {捺印欄|なついんらん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|あ}いています→空く：11062_aku⟧。
examples.english: The seal box has been left blank.

examples.japanese: {右下|みぎした}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{捺印欄|なついんらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{印|いん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}して→押す：02854_osu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please stamp your seal in the box at the bottom right.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{捺印欄|なついんらん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}え→増える：01183_fueru⟧、⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧⟦{署名|しょめい}→署名：03682_shomei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Recently more documents have no seal box, and an electronic signature is enough.

notes:
⟦{捺印|なついん}→捺印：08014_natsuin⟧ (affixing a seal) + ⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ (column, field on a form). Part of a family of form-field words built with ⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧, such as ⟦{署名欄|しょめいらん}→署名欄：30137_shomeiran⟧ and ⟦{記入欄|きにゅうらん}→記入欄：21276_kinyuuran⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {捺印欄|なついんらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: to stamp in the seal box
- {捺印欄|なついんらん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空白|くうはく}→空白：15426_kuuhaku⟧: the seal box is blank
- {捺印欄|なついんらん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧: to provide a seal box

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{署名欄|しょめいらん}→署名欄：30137_shomeiran⟧: signature field — for a handwritten name instead of a seal
- ⟦{記入欄|きにゅうらん}→記入欄：21276_kinyuuran⟧: entry field — any blank to be filled in
